nodes.label: In-App Notification Center (GET /notifications, unread-count, read endpoints)
nodes.rationale: Authenticated inbox for non-critical application events; email opt-out preferences never disable in-app notifications; the inbox stays the reliable source even when the real-time channel is unavailable.

nodes.label: SSE Real-Time Notification Channel (GET /notifications/stream)
nodes.rationale: SSE was chosen for local simplicity and compatibility with Next server-rendering; polling/server-rendered is only a resilience fallback. Current fan-out is in-memory in the API process, fine for single instance, but must be replaced/augmented with Redis Pub/Sub, Redis streams or a broker before scaling to multiple instances.

nodes.label: Notification Event Types (review submission, contact request, moderation decision, report decision)
